verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's first-party docs describe a delegate_task tool that lets the AI hand work to parallel sub-agents, each a full chat with tool access. A separate use-case page shows running parallel agents on git worktrees, one agent per workspace, supervised from a single browser tab. Missing for 10: detail on how sub-agent results are aggregated and coordinated, any agent-to-agent protocol or swarm support, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works on real tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can work together — subagents, swarms, or an agent-to-agent protocol that splits and parallelizes real work

citations.quote: The AI can delegate work to parallel sub-agents with the delegate_task tool. Each sub-agent is a full chat with tool access
one worktree per task, one workspace per worktree, one agent per workspace, all supervised from a single browser tab.
